population: 169 original development laps, 40 recording blocks; exclude historical 36 test laps before representations. Preserve all 205 validated laps.
folds: Exactly DEVELOPMENT_FOLDS_V072.csv. Outer held-out blocks never early-stop. Inner validation: seed 420+fold permutation of sorted outer-training blocks, first 4 blocks. GRU normalization fits inner training only; retain inner-fit model for outer evaluation, no outer refit.
checkpoint_strategy: Time fallback. Nominal 5,10,15,... seconds until last valid in-lap observation; retain measured last observation <= nominal, 100ms freshness, source gaps <=200ms. Cadence configurable; sparse compatibility 10,20,30,45,60. No percentage or final-duration-derived input.
progress: Car Pos Norm not enabled: exact ACTI export mapping/interpolation/latency unverified. Audit full development laps without admitting field as predictor. No normalization by completed duration/distance.
SVR-SPARSE: Unchanged RBF SVR C10 epsilon0.5 gamma scale, 13 original features, original five training checkpoints. Same frozen fold fitted parameters used for both sparse and dense inference. Verify original sparse predictions against frozen v072 F0. Production v071 fixed SVR additionally gets dense inference on original validation only, reported separately, without parameter change.
SVR-DENSE: Same settings/features, dense training, direct final-seconds target. Lap-balanced weights normalized to mean snapshot weight 1; each lap total same, C unchanged. Sparse preprocessing unweighted as original; dense imputer/scaler training only, unweighted; disclose cadence/feature-distribution change.
SVR-REMAINING: Same dense rows/features/settings/weights, label target_s-observed_elapsed_s. Reconstruct observed_elapsed_s+max(0,raw_remaining). Save negative raw outputs, projections and raw final predictions. No tuning.
REMAINING-REFERENCE: Training unique targets T conditional on T>observed_elapsed. Predict elapsed+median(T-elapsed). If empty, elapsed+0; disclose support count. Survival-conditioned population baseline, not physical position. The live in-lap state implies T>elapsed but never reveals eventual target.
sequence: Six channels speed/throttle/brake/RPM/gear/steering, steering only declared deg. Last-known-only 10Hz resampling <= observed cutoff, max age 200ms, no future interpolation. Full prefix compressed to nonoverlapping 2-second chunks of 10Hz observed samples; six means, six availability fractions, observed chunk duration/2. Include last partial chunk and actual terminal observation. Never truncate to60s. Fixed support ceiling600s/301 chunks, independent of evaluated final duration. Explicit boolean right-padding mask. Same chunks and F0 context for Ridge and GRU.
normalization: Sequence imputation median and mean/std on unique longest-prefix training-lap chunks (not repeated prefixes); missing indicators retained. F0 context median/scaler fitted training only. Ridge uses outer training, GRU inner training. Labels joined only after observations built.
RIDGE-ORDERED: One Ridge alpha100, flattened ordered chunks with fixed600s zero padding plus masks and standardized F0 context; same remaining target/projection as GRU. No algorithm/alpha search.
GRU: Keras existing Torch CPU backend, seed42+fold, one GRU16 L2=0.001, concatenate same F0 context, Dense8 relu, Dense1 standardized remaining target. Train-only weighted output mean/std and exact inverse. Adam0.003 clipnorm1 MSE, max20epochs, batch64, inner early stopping patience4 restore best, no architecture search. CPU torch threads2. Final research fit all169 development for median outer best epoch count; normalization all development, in-sample clearly labelled.
weights: Every training lap equal total loss weight despite variable checkpoint count. Metrics primary equal lap: inverse checkpoint count within each reported subset. Recording macro mean of per-lap mean errors per block. Checkpoint tables one observation per surviving lap; report changing survivor counts. Also shared <=60s and original sparse matched comparisons.
late_reporting: Actual seconds by checkpoint plus early<=30, middle30..60, late>60. Last scheduled observation per lap and retrospective final10s band separately, target-derived bands ONLY after inference, never live percent/input. Survival selection limits comparisons of different elapsed checkpoints.
metrics: Lap-balanced MAE RMSE bias median P90 max, recording macro, frozen descriptive originalTRAIN quartiles109.734/140.04333333333335, calibration prediction-on-actual slope, SD ratio; per fold/checkpoint/pace/stage and consecutive-error improvements/jump sizes. Save projection impact and counts, all difficult laps retained.
ablation: Cadence-only same sparse fitted SVR; dense-direct versus sparse matched observations; remaining versus dense-direct same features; ordered Ridge versus remaining SVR (representation and estimator both change); GRU versus Ridge same chunk information/target but different estimators, inner training population and regularization. No verified progress ablation possible. Do not claim isolated temporal-order causality without shuffled-order control.
artifacts: Separate artifacts/barcelona_v080. Save signed classical bundles and SHA/HMAC-verified .keras before safe_mode load. Bind domain, corpus/dev IDs, feature/version/protocol/fold hashes. No fit/download on normal Streamlit rerun. Historical IDs rejected by research inference.
decision: Operational reference always v071. Exploratory recommendation only; no automatic promotion. New untouched observations required for final performance claims. No further candidates or tuning after results.
